why: Done, but odd-looking: the profile is one closed polyline (flag 70 = 1, the eight profile corners) and both wheels are on WHEELS. Save As kept the file type from the learner's last laser-cutter job, AutoCAD R12/LT2 DXF ($ACADVER AC1009), and R12 has no LWPOLYLINE: the same closed polyline is written as POLYLINE + VERTEX + SEQEND. The step asks for toy_car.dxf, not a DXF version.

step.title: Profile and wheel layer
step.instructions: Draw the side profile as one closed polyline (PLINE, finish with C), make a layer WHEELS and put both wheel circles on it. Save the drawing as toy_car.dxf.
